$comment: SC8a Task 2 input: chain facts + external (non-REX) contracts consumed by the deploy scripts and
post-deploy checks (Tasks 3+). Shape = `NetworkConfig` in services/src/config/deployments.types.ts,
re-declared (NOT imported -- @rex/ops never depends on @rex/services) in ops/src/config/networks.ts.
`null` on any `contracts` field = unresolved known-unknown -- a consumer MUST fail closed via
resolveExternal(), never substitute a default or guess an address.
`local` is intentionally ABSENT here: the local devnet (anvil/hardhat) writes its own entry at
runtime once it deploys mock tokens/routes -- it is never committed to this file.
Values below are the confirmed testnet reference set (docs/references/config-values.md):
home = Sepolia. chainId 11155111; hyperlaneDomain 11155111 (equals chainId on Sepolia).
fund = PRUV testnet. hyperlaneDomain 7336; chainId 7336 (Derryl, 2026-07-15).
mailbox (both chains): resolved 2026-08-04, read from each USDC route's mailbox().
usdcWarpRoute / wrwaWarpRoute ("TREX01"): Derryl-canonical addresses (2026-08-04 / 2026-07-14).
usdc: FakeUSDC, same address both chains (decimals 6); RWAToken.asset() confirmed == this token.
fund.contracts.rwaToken: PRUV RWAToken, decimals 6. config-values.md section 2 shows this address
truncated (0x5d5c78...) next to the decimals fact, but section 3's 'RWAToken address' row
carries the FULL address (Pruv owner, 2026-07-14) -- used verbatim below, not invented. Still
build-time-verify decimals()==6 and asset()==usdc before relying on it (BE3 deploy check).
fund.contracts.rwaConversion: PRUV RWAConversion (proxy), full address given in config-values.md
section 3's 'RWAConversion address' row (read on-chain 2026-08-02 via vault.rwaConversion()).
fund.explorerUrl left "" -- no PRUV testnet block explorer confirmed yet.
home.rpcUrl is an env placeholder (${SEPOLIA_RPC_URL}) -- no key invented; fund.rpcUrl is the
confirmed literal rpc.testnet.pruv.network endpoint (chainId 7336, verified 2026-07-15).
2026-08-24 route swap (AT-190/AT-191): Derryl REDEPLOYED the warp routes with fee=0 (lost the
key to zero the fee on the old routes). ONLY the 4 warp-route addresses changed; usdc, rwaToken,
rwaConversion and both mailboxes are UNCHANGED (verified on-chain: new routes wrappedToken() ==
old usdc 0x756EfF / old rwaToken 0x5d5c78, mailbox() == old mailboxes, quote fee == 0). New
routes: home usdc 0xB1fdEC0e (collateral) / home wrwa 0x598fA0aE (synthetic); fund usdc
0x725e38 (collateral) / fund wrwa 0x660F41 (collateral). Old routes (0xd753b4/0xD8d3947a/
0x7190D4BB/0x159E57) still charge 0.75 USDC and still hold the 2 stuck live batches -- orphaned,
separate cleanup. REX must REDEPLOY (routes are immutable ctor args) to move onto these.
rexRegistry (SC7a, ADR-021): the ONE global home-chain REXRegistry. null until deployed --
fail closed on it, never guess. It sits here rather than in home.contracts (that shape
mirrors services/src/config/deployments.types.ts and must not drift) and rather than in
config/deployments.json (whose entries are per-version deployments, ADR-011).
rexRegistryV2 (ADR-032): the flat v2 directory. null until deployed. rexRegistry (v1) stays
recorded while a v1 instance is live and BE6 has not cut over; the two are independent
contracts, not versions of one address.
defaultFund (SC7b-1): names the fund file whose `contracts` block is DUPLICATED below in
fund.contracts.rwaToken / rwaConversion / wrwaWarpRoute and home.contracts.wrwaWarpRoute.
Those four are per FUND, not per chain -- they live here only because ops' non-deploy
verbs and the services mirror read them here. The deploy scripts read them from the fund
file (config/deploy/<fund>.params.json) and REVERT on any drift between the two copies
(DeployConfig.requireFundMatchesNetworks). A SECOND fund adds its own fund file and
changes NOTHING here.
